workload.name: Cache save and restore, 4 GB
workload.description: A 4 GB random file saved with a cache action, deleted, restored right away on the same runner, and checked to be complete: actions/cache (GitHub's cache service, or whatever the provider routes it to) and the provider's own cache action where the provider still recommends one (Blacksmith archived useblacksmith/cache: actions/cache is routed to its cache). No pause between save and restore, so a cache that isn't read-after-write consistent shows up as a failure. File generation is not timed.

runners.label: ubuntu-24.04
runners.note: Standard 4 vCPU runner GitHub gives public repositories.

suiteNotes.burst: Jobs started in waves as earlier ones finished: the plan this benchmark account is on caps how many run at once, so this queue measures that cap, not how fast the platform scales.
